description: First-visit AGM tips — rendered once per screen via isFirstVisit(). Sprint 43.

/.title: Your command center
/.body: Everything that matters this week is surfaced here. When in doubt, start on the dashboard and work outward.

/roster.title: Know your 53
/roster.body: Sort by overall, age, or contract status. The players you see here are the ones you ride with — or the ones you cut.

/depth-chart.title: Who plays when it matters
/depth-chart.body: Order your starters by role. Injuries and fatigue will roll the backups in — if that scares you, fix it here first.

/schedule.title: The year ahead
/schedule.body: Every opponent, every week. Tough stretches coming? Rest starters early. Easy stretch? Push for seeding.

/standings.title: Where you stack up
/standings.body: Division first, conference second. The tie-breakers in week 17 are built on the decisions you make in weeks 1-16.

/inbox.title: The league is talking
/inbox.body: Press conferences, front-office memos, rival moves — the inbox is how the league tells you what it thinks of your team.

/game-plan.title: Beat them before kickoff
/game-plan.body: Your scheme vs. their personnel. Match strengths to weaknesses. A good plan turns a coin-flip into a two-score game.

/contracts.title: The cap is a scoreboard too
/contracts.body: Every dollar in dead money is a dollar you can't spend on talent. Restructure when it helps; walk away when it doesn't.

/trades.title: Every team has needs
/trades.body: The best trades make both sides better. Find a GM whose pain is your surplus, and don't be afraid to include a pick.

/scouting.title: Know before you draft
/scouting.body: Scouting budget is finite. Spend it where your roster will be thin in three years, not where it's deep today.

/draft.title: The future gets drafted today
/draft.body: Board vs. need. Best player available wins more championships than reaching for fit — but you still need a QB.

/free-agency.title: Spend with intention
/free-agency.body: Free agents are expensive for a reason. Pay for scheme fits and role-specific skills, not name recognition.

/training-camp.title: Camp makes the team
/training-camp.body: Reps build chemistry and catch injuries early. Cut decisions you make here live with you all season.

/briefing.title: One screen, one week
/briefing.body: Your Monday Briefing is where the week begins. Read what your AGM flags before you click Advance.

/broadcast.title: Watch the story tell itself
/broadcast.body: Game Day replays show the swing plays and key drives. Great for figuring out why you lost — or why you won.

/franchise.title: The long game
/franchise.body: Owner mood, dynasty window, franchise doctrines. This is the pulse of everything you've built.
